title: CFA lane 5: fixed income (pricing, yield, duration, spreads)
mission: Curate atomic, reusable fixed-income relationships: bond pricing from yield, yield measures in closed form, spot/forward rate arithmetic, duration/convexity approximations, and spread definitions, each with explicit compounding, day-count and timing conventions. Bond arithmetic only; continue through successive batches with no trading chain required.
priorities: Option-free bond price from coupon, par, yield and periods with explicit timing and compounding
Current yield, yield to maturity definitional form, and effective annual yield conversions in closed form
Spot/forward rate identities and forward pricing from spot curves with stated compounding
Macaulay and modified duration from cash-flow timing with stated yield scope
Duration-based price approximation and convexity adjustment as separate guarded records
PV01/DV01 and price-value-of-basis-point arithmetic with stated notional scope
Credit spread definitions (G-spread, I-spread, Z-spread, OAS conceptually) as definitional records where closed-form
Accrued interest and clean/dirty price identities with stated day-count scope
boundaries: This lane owns fixed-income arithmetic; equity valuation, derivatives pricing, statement ratios and portfolio records belong to lanes 1-4 and 6.
Do not resubmit the 14 covered TVM-family IDs as new coverage; bond pricing with coupons/par is a distinct record with its own sources and overlap notes.
Iterative yield-to-maturity solving is out of engine reach: record YTM definitionally with closed-form special cases, and defer iterative solving with exact sources.
Binomial/tree pricing and Monte-Carlo valuation are excluded from completed records; defer with sources.
Day-count, compounding and settlement-timing conventions are part of every record; records that silently assume one convention fail review.
starter_sources: Owner excerpt packet for this lane (discovery leads with exact PDF locators; corroborate every record against a directly inspected accessible source).
A public fixed-income text with the same formulas (for example OpenStax Principles of Finance); record exact book, edition and section, never cite a root URL as evidence.
special_checks: Independently sum discounted coupons plus par for bond-price references instead of repeating the closed form.
Coupon frequency, compounding frequency and yield-quoting convention are stated and consistent within each record.
Duration/convexity records state the small-yield-change scope and reject large-shift misuse in limitations.
Test zero-coupon and par-bond boundaries explicitly.
integration_expectation: New meanings (bond_price, yield_to_maturity, macaulay_duration, convexity_adjustment, credit_spread and similar) require extension; coupon sums fit the engine via sum over index families once meanings exist. Percent-quoted yields follow the canonical-units rule (no inlined /100). Never relabel a spread as a discount rate to force execution.
coverage_guidance: Priorities are seeds, not a finite checklist. Continue into adjacent fixed-income readings inside the boundaries, selecting independently reusable relationships. Save multiple bounded batches without waiting for owner review. Check supplied inventory and prior returns for equivalent relationships and conflicting IDs. Record out-of-format discoveries as deferred with exact sources and missing capabilities; do not force chains or dilute quality for a quota.
